_comment: Single source of truth for this Actor's pay-per-event pricing.
Apify does not read this file. actor.json has no pricing field and the CLI has no pricing
command, so the prices would otherwise live only in the Console with no history or review.
HOW TO APPLY IT (measured against the live API on 2026-09-14, not read off the docs):
PUT /v2/acts/{actorId} DOES accept a `pricingInfos` body field, even though the public
API reference lists it as response-only. Proof: an unknown field returns
So the real prerequisite is payout billing info on the account, set once at
https://console.apify.com/actors/{actorId}/publication (a KYC step, not an API one).
Once that exists, apply these prices with PUT /v2/acts/{actorId}; the exact nesting under
because the billing gate rejects before shape validation. Verify against the Console

app-checked.eventDescription: One app in one country checked against its store for new reviews, including the app-name lookup and all review pages fetched for it.
